sources.examined: Complete text kernel, including its warning, pole, prime meridian and radii.
sources.finding: The release explicitly uses placeholder pole RA 0 and Dec 90. Its single-ellipsoid radii 0.260, 0.110, 0.105 km do not bind the current two-lobe surface to Lucy images.

sources.examined: Complete delta collection inventory and directory listing.
sources.finding: The added document concerns the Donaldjohanson coordinate system, not a Selam registration release.

sources.examined: Complete inventory and directory listing; checked the predecessor collection because v2 is a delta.
sources.finding: The collection lists mission and instrument papers. It is not a numerical Selam surface/control release.

sources.examined: Sections 2.2 and 3.1, Selam-specific shape and image references, and data availability. The full PDF was retrieved; this was a targeted reading, not a review of every result.
sources.finding: Section 3.1 explicitly uses unprojected lor_0752129590_03608 for Selam crater measurements because Selam has no shape model. The newer numerical shape discussed elsewhere belongs to Dinkinesh.

decision: Resolved images remain available, but these sources do not qualify registration to the fixed two-lobe envelope. Do not use the placeholder PCK or the Dinkinesh shape as Selam controls.
revisitWhen: A numerical Selam reference surface and matched image controls, or an independently qualified measured registration, establish surface correspondence to the selected representation.
